reason: I'd probably use the free visit to see it, but $13 a go plus the coffee I don't need adds up fast when we're on one shift-work paycheck and the library and parks are free. Unlimited at $45 is more than I'd spend on fun in a month.
objection: Thirteen dollars every time I leave the house with a toddler, when I can do the library story time or the park for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Drop-in around $8 for a weekday, or a cheap weekday-morning rate for hospital shift families.
